literal: Langjun Lao, envoy to Shazhou, returned; an edict pardoned his accumulated punishments.
idiomatic: Langjun Lao, envoy to Shazhou, returned, and an edict pardoned his accumulated punishments.

literal: By old custom when dispatching envoys to distant states, the state often used convicts who possessed talent and ability; when they returned, their crimes were remitted.
idiomatic: By old custom when the state dispatched envoys to distant countries it often chose convicts who possessed talent and ability; when they returned, their crimes were remitted.

literal: On wuzi day the Southwestern Road pacification commissioner memorialized that among the Tangut tribes the Songxi clan had not delivered tribute on schedule and often harbored other intentions; envoys should be sent in season to supervise them.
idiomatic: On wuzi day the Southwestern Road pacification commissioner reported that among the Tangut tribes the Songxi clan had not delivered tribute on schedule and often harbored other intentions, and that envoys should be sent in season to supervise them.

literal: An edict said: "The petty tribes on the frontier have annual fixed tribute.
idiomatic: An edict said: "The petty tribes on the frontier owe annual fixed tribute.

literal: Frontier officials are arrogant and unrestrained, levying without limit; they harbor fear but cannot speak for themselves.
idiomatic: Frontier officials are arrogant and unrestrained and levy without limit; the tribes live in fear but cannot make themselves heard.

literal: Just send upright and cautious officials and generals, show them favor and good faith, and let no one encroach or plunder, and they will naturally submit.
idiomatic: Simply send upright and cautious officials and generals, show them favor and good faith, and let no one encroach or plunder, and they will naturally submit."

literal: They again memorialized that the Diju and Dieliede tribes said pacification commissioner Han Liu had benevolent governance and his term was now ending; they requested he be retained.
idiomatic: They again reported that the Diju and Dieliede tribes said pacification commissioner Han Liu had governed benevolently and his term was now ending, and asked that he be retained.

literal: The Emperor ordered his governance record submitted.
idiomatic: The Emperor ordered his record of governance submitted.

literal: On xinchou day the court went to the Central Capital.
idiomatic: On xinchou day the court went to the Central Capital.

literal: On renyin day the Dashi state sent envoys presenting an elephant and regional products, requesting a marriage alliance on behalf of the prince Zicege.
idiomatic: On renyin day the Dashi state sent envoys presenting an elephant and regional products and requesting a marriage alliance on behalf of Prince Zicege.

literal: Eleventh month, on dingsi day Qishui Commandery King Han Zhixin was made Nanjing regent, Xijin intendant, and supreme commander of troops and horses.
idiomatic: On dingsi day of the eleventh month Qishui Commandery King Han Zhixin was appointed Nanjing regent, Xijin intendant, and supreme commander of troops and horses.

literal: On jiwei day yilibi Xiao Xiaoshun was made supreme commander of all Southern Route mobile palaces and promoted to Left Vice Director.
idiomatic: On jiwei day yilibi Xiao Xiaoshun was made supreme commander of all Southern Route mobile palaces and promoted to Left Vice Director.

literal: Twelfth month, on dinghai day burning of the body and charring of fingers by monks was forbidden.
idiomatic: On dinghai day of the twelfth month monks were forbidden to burn their bodies or char their fingers.

literal: On wuzi day an edict ordered construction of the Taizu temple at the Central Capital, with regulations and ritual vessels all following ancient standards.
idiomatic: On wuzi day an edict ordered construction of the Taizu temple at the Central Capital, with regulations and ritual vessels all following ancient standards.

literal: On yisi day an edict ordered that the great enfeoffment rite be performed the coming winter.
idiomatic: On yisi day an edict ordered that the great enfeoffment rite be performed the coming winter.

literal: Jinshi Zhang Zhongju and forty-five others passed the examinations.
idiomatic: Jinshi Zhang Zhongju and forty-five others passed the examinations.

literal: First year of Taiping, spring, first month, on the dingchou new moon Song envoys Lu Zongdao and Cheng Ji came to offer congratulations.
idiomatic: In the first year of Taiping, on the dingchou new moon of the first spring month Song envoys Lu Zongdao and Cheng Ji came to offer congratulations.

literal: The court went to the Hun River.
idiomatic: The court went to the Hun River.

literal: Second month, on yimao day the court visited the Bo River.
idiomatic: On yimao day of the second month the court visited the Bo River.

literal: On renxu day hunted at Gaoliu Forest.
idiomatic: On renxu day the court hunted at Gaoliu Forest.

literal: Third month, on wuxu day Prince Boyizhi was born.
idiomatic: On wuxu day of the third month Prince Boyizhi was born.

literal: On gengzi day imperial son-in-law Commandant Xiao Shaoye built a private walled town; it was granted the name Muzhou, army designation Changqing.
idiomatic: On gengzi day imperial son-in-law Commandant Xiao Shaoye built a private walled town that was granted the name Muzhou, with army designation Changqing.

literal: That month the King of Dashi again sent envoys requesting marriage; Prince Banlangjun Husili's daughter Kelao was enfeoffed as princess and married to him.
idiomatic: That month the King of Dashi again sent envoys requesting marriage; Prince Banlangjun Husili's daughter Kelao was enfeoffed as princess and married to him.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on wushen day the Eastern Capital regent memorialized that chiefs of thirty Jurchen tribes each requested to send their sons to the court to wait on attendance.
idiomatic: On wushen day of the fourth summer month the Eastern Capital regent reported that chiefs of thirty Jurchen tribes each asked to send their sons to the court to wait on attendance.

literal: An edict ordered them to come with their fathers to receive covenant.
idiomatic: An edict ordered them to come with their fathers to receive covenant.

literal: On yimao day prisoners were reviewed.
idiomatic: On yimao day the court reviewed prisoners.

literal: On dingmao day Laizhou was established; that month the court took the summer retreat at Mianshan.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Laizhou was established; that month the court took the summer retreat at Mianshan.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the jiaxu new moon Jurchen who had accompanied the hunts were granted autumn garments.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu new moon of the seventh autumn month Jurchen who had accompanied the hunts were granted autumn garments.

literal: On yihai day Guli was dispatched to retrieve the jade seal that Later Jin had presented, from the Central Capital.
idiomatic: On yihai day Guli was sent to retrieve from the Central Capital the jade seal that Later Jin had presented.

literal: The Zubu came with tribute.
idiomatic: The Zubu came with tribute.

literal: On xinsi day the court went to Shaling.
idiomatic: On xinsi day the court went to Shaling.

literal: That month hunted on the Huang River.
idiomatic: That month the court hunted on the Huang River.

literal: Ninth month, the court visited the Central Capital.
idiomatic: In the ninth month the court visited the Central Capital.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingwei day Dilie chief Pobai came with tribute of horses and camels.
idiomatic: On dingwei day of the tenth winter month Dilie chief Pobai came with tribute of horses and camels.

literal: On wushen day prisoners were reviewed.
idiomatic: On wushen day the court reviewed prisoners.

literal: On renzi day Song envoys Li Yi and Wang Zhongbin came to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival, and Su Weifu and Zhou Ding to congratulate the coming New Year's Day; envoys Xiao Shan and Cheng Zhu were immediately dispatched on a return mission.
idiomatic: On renzi day Song envoys Li Yi and Wang Zhongbin came to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival and Su Weifu and Zhou Ding to congratulate the coming New Year's Day; Xiao Shan and Cheng Zhu were immediately sent on a return mission.

literal: Tangut chief Helu came with tribute.
idiomatic: Tangut chief Helu came with tribute.

literal: On jiwei day Sa Minjieli was made supreme inspector, Gao Liu deputy inspector, Yelü Luohannu Left Pishi xiangwen, Sanggu Right Pishi xiangwen, Liaoliao Northwestern Route jinwu, Yelü Shengyin Censor-in-Chief, Qiuge Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-law, and Xiao Chun and Guli both made great generals.
idiomatic: On jiwei day Sa Minjieli was appointed supreme inspector, Gao Liu deputy inspector, Yelü Luohannu Left Pishi xiangwen, Sanggu Right Pishi xiangwen, Liaoliao Northwestern Route jinwu, Yelü Shengyin Censor-in-Chief, and Qiuge Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-law; Xiao Chun and Guli were both made great generals.

literal: On gengshen day the court visited Tongtian Observatory to watch dragon-and-fish aquatic performances.
idiomatic: On gengshen day the court visited Tongtian Observatory to watch dragon-and-fish aquatic performances.

literal: The next day the court visited again.
idiomatic: The next day the court visited again.

literal: Returning, the Emperor ascended the jade carriage, entered Wanshou Hall through the inner three gates, offered wine before the imperial portraits of the seven temples, and then feasted the imperial clan.
idiomatic: On returning the Emperor ascended the jade carriage, entered Wanshou Hall through the inner three gates, offered wine before the imperial portraits of the seven temples, and then feasted the imperial clan.

literal: Eleventh month, on guiwei day the Emperor presided at Zhaqing Hall; civil and military officials presented the register and bestowed the honorific Sagaciously Cultured, Heroically Martial, Conforming to the Way, Utmost Virtue, Reverently Humane, Broadly Filial, Meritoriously Accomplished, Governingly Settled, Brilliantly Sage, Spiritually Praised, Heaven-Assisted Emperor; a grand amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed to Taiping, and officials at home and abroad were promoted in varying measure.
idiomatic: On guiwei day of the eleventh month the Emperor presided at Zhaqing Hall; civil and military officials presented the register and bestowed the honorific Sagaciously Cultured, Heroically Martial, Conforming to the Way, Utmost Virtue, Reverently Humane, Broadly Filial, Meritoriously Accomplished, Governingly Settled, Brilliantly Sage, Spiritually Praised, Heaven-Assisted Emperor; a grand amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed to Taiping, and officials at home and abroad were promoted in varying measure.

literal: Song dispatched envoys on a goodwill mission; Xia and Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Song dispatched envoys on a goodwill mission, and Xia and Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On jiashen day Prince of Liang Zongzhen was invested as crown prince.
idiomatic: On jiashen day Prince of Liang Zongzhen was invested as crown prince.

literal: Second year, spring, first month, the court fished at Nashui.
idiomatic: In the second year, during the first spring month, the court fished at Nashui.

literal: Second month, on the xinchou new moon encamped at Yu'er Marsh.
idiomatic: On the xinchou new moon of the second month the court encamped at Yu'er Marsh.

literal: Third month, on jiaxu day the court went to Changchun Prefecture.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the third month the court went to Changchun Prefecture.

literal: On dingchou day Song envoy Xue Yikuo came announcing that Song Emperor Zhen had died and his son Zhen had succeeded.
idiomatic: On dingchou day Song envoy Xue Yikuo came announcing that Song Emperor Zhen had died and his son Zhen had succeeded.

literal: Supreme inspector Yelü Shengyin and others were dispatched as Song mourning sacrifice envoys; linya Xiao Rixin and inspection commissioner Feng Yanxiu as Song post-funeral condolence envoys.
idiomatic: Supreme inspector Yelü Shengyin and others were sent as Song mourning sacrifice envoys, and linya Xiao Rixin and inspection commissioner Feng Yanxiu as Song post-funeral condolence envoys.

literal: On wuyin day jinwu Yelü Xieling and introducing commissioner Yao Juxin were dispatched as envoys to condole on the late Song emperor.
idiomatic: On wuyin day jinwu Yelü Xieling and introducing commissioner Yao Juxin were sent as envoys to condole on the late Song emperor.

literal: On wuzi day monks in the three capitals were fed on behalf of the late Song emperor.
idiomatic: On wuzi day monks in the three capitals were fed on behalf of the late Song emperor.

literal: That month an earthquake struck; in Yun and Ying prefectures houses collapsed and ground sank; Mount Weibai split for several hundred paces and springs gushed forth into streams.
idiomatic: That month an earthquake struck; in Yun and Ying prefectures houses collapsed and the ground sank; Mount Weibai split for several hundred paces and springs gushed forth into streams.

literal: Summer, fourth month, the court went to Mianshan for the summer retreat.
idiomatic: In the fourth summer month the court went to Mianshan for the summer retreat.

literal: Fifth month, on yihai day Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner Shi Yongzhong died.
idiomatic: On yihai day of the fifth month Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner Shi Yongzhong died.

literal: On gengchen day Iron Li sent envoys presenting sixteen Wurang households.
idiomatic: On gengchen day Iron Li sent envoys presenting sixteen Wurang households.

literal: Sixth month, on jiwei day Song sent envoys including Xue You bearing keepsakes of the late emperor.
idiomatic: On jiwei day of the sixth month Song sent envoys including Xue You bearing keepsakes of the late emperor.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on yimao day Yelü Xinning was made military commissioner of the Fengling Army, Goryeo Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner Wang Tongxian military commissioner of the Jinghai Army, Yelü Suizhong military commissioner of the Changning Army, Geng Yanji military commissioner of the Zhaode Army, and Gao Shouzhen military commissioner of the Hexi Army.
idiomatic: On yimao day of the seventh autumn month Yelü Xinning was appointed military commissioner of the Fengling Army, Goryeo Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner Wang Tongxian military commissioner of the Jinghai Army, Yelü Suizhong military commissioner of the Changning Army, Geng Yanji military commissioner of the Zhaode Army, and Gao Shouzhen military commissioner of the Hexi Army.

literal: Ninth month, on guisi day Minister Yelü Shengyin and Han Ge were dispatched to congratulate the Song emperor on his accession.
idiomatic: On guisi day of the ninth month Minister Yelü Shengyin and Han Ge were sent to congratulate the Song emperor on his accession.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on renyin day palace rear official Zhang Kegong was dispatched as envoy to congratulate Western Xia King Li Dezhao on his birthday; Yelü Saogu and Han Wang as envoys to congratulate the Song empress dowager on her birthday; and Yelü Xianning and Shi Kezhong as envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.
idiomatic: On renyin day of the tenth winter month palace rear official Zhang Kegong was sent to congratulate Western Xia King Li Dezhao on his birthday; Yelü Saogu and Han Wang to congratulate the Song empress dowager on her birthday; and Yelü Xianning and Shi Kezhong to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.

literal: That month encamped at Hulugusi Marsh.
idiomatic: That month the court encamped at Hulugusi Marsh.

literal: On guimao day Chief Minister Lü Demao, Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner Wu Shuda, Privy Council Vice Commissioner Yang Youxuan, and Right Chancellor Ma Baozhong were granted money and goods in varying measure.
idiomatic: On guimao day Chief Minister Lü Demao, Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner Wu Shuda, Privy Council Vice Commissioner Yang Youxuan, and Right Chancellor Ma Baozhong were granted money and goods in varying measure.

literal: On xinhai day the court reached the Upper Capital and proclaimed a limited amnesty for prisoners within the capital district.
idiomatic: On xinhai day the court reached the Upper Capital and proclaimed a limited amnesty for prisoners within the capital district.

literal: Eleventh month, on bingxu day Song dispatched envoys to express thanks.
idiomatic: On bingxu day of the eleventh month Song sent envoys to express thanks.

literal: Twelfth month, on xinchou day Goryeo King Xun died; his son Qin sent envoys to report it, and envoys were immediately ordered to invest Qin as King of Goryeo.
idiomatic: On xinchou day of the twelfth month Goryeo King Xun died; his son Qin sent envoys to report it, and envoys were immediately ordered to invest Qin as King of Goryeo.

literal: On jiayin day Song sent Liu Ye and Guo Zhiyan to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Song sent Liu Ye and Guo Zhiyan to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

literal: That year jinshi Zhang Jian and forty-seven others passed the examinations.
idiomatic: That year jinshi Zhang Jian and forty-seven others passed the examinations.

literal: Third year, spring, first month, on the bingyin new moon the court fished at Nashui.
idiomatic: In the third year, on the bingyin new moon of the first spring month the court fished at Nashui.

literal: Yelü Shengyin was made Political Affairs Commissioner.
idiomatic: Yelü Shengyin was appointed Political Affairs Commissioner.

literal: On yihai day Xiao Taide was made Southern Palace supreme supervisor; linya Yelü Xinning Northwestern Route pacification supreme supervisor.
idiomatic: On yihai day Xiao Taide was appointed Southern Palace supreme supervisor and linya Yelü Xinning Northwestern Route pacification supreme supervisor.

literal: On xinsi day the private walled town of the Princess of Yue was granted the name Yizhou, army designation Qingyi.
idiomatic: On xinsi day the private walled town of the Princess of Yue was granted the name Yizhou, with army designation Qingyi.

literal: Second month, on bingshen day Ding Zhen was made military commissioner of the Wuxin Army and his fief was changed to Prince of Lanling Commandery.
idiomatic: On bingshen day of the second month Ding Zhen was appointed military commissioner of the Wuxin Army and his fief was changed to Prince of Lanling Commandery.

literal: On wushen day Eastern Plain Commandery King Xiao Paiya was made Southwestern Route supreme pacification commissioner and advanced to King of Bin.
idiomatic: On wushen day Eastern Plain Commandery King Xiao Paiya was appointed Southwestern Route supreme pacification commissioner and advanced to King of Bin.

literal: Summer, fourth month, Yelü Shouning was made supreme inspector.
idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Yelü Shouning was appointed supreme inspector.

literal: Fifth month, summer retreat at Mianshan.
idiomatic: In the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Mianshan.

literal: Sixth month, on wushen day Southern Court xuanhui commissioner Liu Jing was made associate administrative affairs commissioner; Xiao Xiaohui was made deputy inspector; Xiao Xiaogong was made Eastern Capital commander and concurrent frontier inspection commissioner.
idiomatic: On wushen day of the sixth month Southern Court xuanhui commissioner Liu Jing was appointed associate administrative affairs commissioner; Xiao Xiaohui was made deputy inspector; and Xiao Xiaogong was made Eastern Capital commander and concurrent frontier inspection commissioner.

literal: On wuwu day Xiao Lian was made Left yilibi and Xiao Lin xiangwen.
idiomatic: On wuwu day Xiao Lian was appointed Left yilibi and Xiao Lin xiangwen.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuyin day Southern Chancellery chancellor Yelü Hege was made Upper Capital regent and enfeoffed as Qishui Commandery King.
idiomatic: On wuyin day of the seventh autumn month Southern Chancellery chancellor Yelü Hege was appointed Upper Capital regent and enfeoffed as Qishui Commandery King.

literal: On bingxu day the Empress's birthday was established as Shuntian Festival.
idiomatic: On bingxu day the Empress's birthday was established as Shuntian Festival.

literal: On dinghai day Mianshan was granted the name Yong'an.
idiomatic: On dinghai day Mianshan was granted the name Yong'an.

literal: That month hunted at Chishan.
idiomatic: That month the court hunted at Chishan.

literal: Intercalary ninth month, on the renchen new moon Xiao Baida and Han Shaoyong were dispatched as envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day; Tang Gude and Cheng Zhaowen as envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor's birthday.
idiomatic: On the renchen new moon of the intercalary ninth month Xiao Baida and Han Shaoyong were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day, and Tang Gude and Cheng Zhaowen as envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor's birthday.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengchen day Song sent Xue Kui and Guo Sheng to congratulate the Shuntian Festival, and Wang Zhen and Murong Weisu to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
idiomatic: On gengchen day of the tenth winter month Song sent Xue Kui and Guo Sheng to congratulate the Shuntian Festival and Wang Zhen and Murong Weisu to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

literal: The Eastern Expedition Army reported: "Commander Xieling and Changgun Kenu led troops in from Maomuguo Ridge; linya Gao Jiu, subordinate general Da Kuangyi, and others led troops in from Gushan Ridge.
idiomatic: The Eastern Expedition Army reported: "Commander Xieling and Changgun Kenu led troops in from Maomuguo Ridge, and linya Gao Jiu, subordinate general Da Kuangyi, and others led troops in from Gushan Ridge.

literal: Intercalary month they had not yet reached Talu River when they returned without encountering the enemy.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month they had not yet reached Talu River when they returned without encountering the enemy.

literal: They rendezvoused at Hongpazhi Ridge that month, and very many camels and horses died.
idiomatic: They rendezvoused at Hongpazhi Ridge that month, and very many camels and horses died."

literal: The court encamped on the Liao River.
idiomatic: The court encamped on the Liao River.

literal: Eleventh month, on the xinmao new moon Imperial Nephew Zongfan was made military commissioner of the Guide Army; Northern Chancellery chancellor Xiao Xiaomu was made Nanjing regent and enfeoffed as King of Yan; Nanjing regent Han Zhixin was made Southern Court Great King and supreme commander of troops and horses; Qiu Zheng was made Yanjing transport commissioner.
idiomatic: On the xinmao new moon of the eleventh month Imperial Nephew Zongfan was appointed military commissioner of the Guide Army; Northern Chancellery chancellor Xiao Xiaomu was made Nanjing regent and enfeoffed as King of Yan; Nanjing regent Han Zhixin was made Southern Court Great King and supreme commander of troops and horses; and Qiu Zheng was made Yanjing transport commissioner.

literal: Twelfth month, on renxu day Zongfan was made Political Affairs Commissioner and enfeoffed as Prince of Three Han Commandery; Qiu Daoheng was made Central Capital deputy regent; Feng Yanxiu was made prefect of Shunzhou.
idiomatic: On renxu day of the twelfth month Zongfan was appointed Political Affairs Commissioner and enfeoffed as Prince of Three Han Commandery; Qiu Daoheng was made Central Capital deputy regent; and Feng Yanxiu was made prefect of Shunzhou.

literal: Lang Xuanhua was made Western Mountains transport commissioner and Zhao Qi Privy Direct Academician.
idiomatic: Lang Xuanhua was appointed Western Mountains transport commissioner and Zhao Qi Privy Direct Academician.

literal: On dingmao day Xiao Yong was made Crown Prince Grand Preceptor.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Xiao Yong was appointed Crown Prince Grand Preceptor.

literal: On jimao day Prince Chongyuan was enfeoffed as King of Qin.
idiomatic: On jimao day Prince Chongyuan was enfeoffed as King of Qin.

literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, on the gengyin new moon Song sent Zhang Chuan, Zhang Shiyu, Cheng Lin, and Ding Baoheng to offer congratulations.
idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the gengyin new moon of the first spring month Song sent Zhang Chuan, Zhang Shiyu, Cheng Lin, and Ding Baoheng to offer congratulations.

literal: The court went to the Yazi River.
idiomatic: The court went to the Yazi River.

literal: Second month, on the jiwei new moon hunted on the Talu River.
idiomatic: On the jiwei new moon of the second month the court hunted on the Talu River.

literal: An edict renamed the Yazi River Huntun River and the Talu River Changchun River.
idiomatic: An edict renamed the Yazi River Huntun River and the Talu River Changchun River.

literal: Third month, on the wuzi new moon, Thousand Age Festival; an edict granted food to elders in the various palace establishments.
idiomatic: On the wuzi new moon of the third month, the Thousand Age Festival, an edict granted food to elders in the various palace establishments.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on guiyou day Right Chancellor Ma Baozhong's son Shihong was sent on a mission beyond the passes; reaching Pingdi Pine Forest he was killed by bandits and was specially posthumously granted military commissioner of the Zhaoxin Army.
idiomatic: On guiyou day of the fourth summer month Right Chancellor Ma Baozhong's son Shihong was sent on a mission beyond the passes; reaching Pingdi Pine Forest he was killed by bandits and was specially posthumously granted military commissioner of the Zhaoxin Army.

literal: Fifth month, summer retreat at Mount Yong'an.
idiomatic: In the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Mount Yong'an.

literal: Sixth month, on jiwei day Southern Court Great King Han Zhixin died.
idiomatic: On jiwei day of the sixth month Southern Court Great King Han Zhixin died.

literal: On wuchen day Zheng Hongjie was made bureau director in the Ministry of War and Liu Shenxing military commissioner of the Shunyi Army.
idiomatic: On wuchen day Zheng Hongjie was appointed bureau director in the Ministry of War and Liu Shenxing military commissioner of the Shunyi Army.
